label: TP
reason: The code exhibits two distinct vulnerabilities: (1) Uses java.util.Random() for cryptographic-sensitive operations (session key generation) which is cryptographically weak per CWE-330; (2) Response output concatenates unsanitized strings directly to HTML without proper escaping, enabling XSS if any variable can be influenced.
